subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should this PR land as a scoped embedded-runtime guard while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92271 remains open for gateway loopback, `sessions_send`/cron scheduling, and native Codex follow-ups?
rationale: The code path is a plausible narrow mitigation, but the original invariant spans multiple work-delegation surfaces and this PR now explicitly leaves several of them out of scope.

options.title: Land Scoped Mitigation After Rebase
options.body: Accept the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard, require a clean rebase and focused validation, and keep the broader issue open for remaining surfaces.

options.title: Require Full Invariant Here
options.body: Hold this PR until gateway loopback, `sessions_send`/cron scheduling, and Codex-owned spawn behavior have an approved single-PR or coordinated implementation plan.

options.title: Pause In Favor Of Canonical Issue
options.body: Close or pause this branch and use the canonical issue to sponsor a broader owner-designed implementation.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Mitigation After Rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard, require a clean rebase and focused validation, and keep the broader issue open for remaining surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and authored the cross-harness review requirements that define the open scope decision.
